selection.promptIntent: Determine the workflow domain first, then select matching domain standards.
selection.capabilities: Match detected technology and output artifacts to capability standards.
selection.client: Select the explicit client profile when provided. If no client is provided, use the default profile only for workflows that explicitly target that client.
selection.fallback: If no capability match exists, continue with common + domain (+ client overlay only when explicitly selected and available).

conflictHandling.commonSafetyRules: Never downgrade security, privacy, or evidence requirements from common standards.
conflictHandling.specificity: More specific applicable layers override broader layers for non-safety rules.
conflictHandling.narrowing: Client overlays may narrow requirements but should not duplicate universal rules unless necessary for clarity.

newClientRequires: whether client-specific overlay is required at onboarding time
